_meta.description: Maps each program in the МУИС dataset (muis-oyutan-mn v2, data/programs.json) to our majors rows, so a yearly refresh can update by id instead of by name.
_meta.how_to_use: Look up the dataset record by dataset_id and update the rows in main_ids (local_ids when present, otherwise the same ids) with its exam split, threshold_score and tuition. db_name is informational: joint programs carry a "(… 1+3)" / "(… 2+2)" suffix and two names were near matches.

match_values.near: same school, our name differs slightly (see dataset_name vs db_name)
match_values.added: row was missing and was inserted from the dataset
match_values.joint: joint program filled into the branch school's existing row and renamed with the suffix
match_values.joint_added: joint version inserted as a new row next to the branch school's own program

_meta.ids_note: Ids are the same on local and main except where local_ids / local_id is given (Баруун бүс rows were added to each database separately).
_meta.repeats_note: Rows listed twice in main_ids are intentional repeats in our program lists.
